plugins.description: Startup equity math done exactly: Paul Graham's equity equation, option pools, SAFEs and notes converting in a priced round, dilution, vesting and exit waterfalls, and a founder's check of their own raise before a VC sees it, with every formula and source shown; plus founder-side reviews of a raise's messaging and claims, each with an adversarial review. More venture-style skills to come.
